game.script:
var startY = 0

on start
    startY = self.y
end

on update
    rotate 0, 120 * dt, 0
    setpos self.x, startY + sin(time * 180) * 0.25, self.z
end

on touch
    if other == "Player" then
        print "Coin collected!"
        hide
    end
end

var speed = 90

on update
    rotate 0, speed * dt, 0
end

on touch
    if other == "Player" then
        message "Ouch! Back to spawn.", 2
        respawn
    end
end

var power = 28

on touch
    if other == "Player" then
        launch 0, power, 0
    end
end

on touch
    if other == "Player" then
        win "Finished in " .. round(time) .. " s!"
    end
end
